title: Italy Backs EU-Wide Rollout of Tesla's Assisted-Driving Software
summary:
Italy's Minister of Infrastructure and Transport Matteo Salvini has called for the prompt authorization of Tesla's automated driving system throughout the European Union. Following a meeting with CEO Elon Musk, Salvini stated that the Italian government is interested in the safety and innovation benefits of the technology and wants to see its deployment expedited across the bloc.

The driver-assist software, known as Tesla Assisted Driving in the region, recently gained regulatory clearance in Latvia and Slovakia. Those latest authorizations increase the number of European nations that have approved the supervised driving system to 10, including Belgium and the Netherlands, as the EU continues to evaluate a wider rollout.
